app.name: AI4BRAIN
app.tagline: Short games to understand how you think, and help you learn better.
app.pitch: You play five short games, about a minute each. They show how you handle five everyday mental skills: remembering, concentrating, switching, reacting and spotting patterns. A coach then suggests what to practise next, and tells you why. It is a learning tool, not a medical test.
steps: See your profile, with honest ranges
Follow the coach's suggestions and watch your progress
app.not_medical: This is not a medical or psychological assessment. No camera, no microphone, no name or email.

working_memory.name: Memory
working_memory.what: Keeping information in mind and updating it.
working_memory.example: Remembering a phone number while you dial it, or following instructions with several steps.

inhibitory_control.name: Focus
inhibitory_control.what: Staying on what matters despite distractions.
inhibitory_control.example: Reading in a noisy cafe or ignoring notifications while you study.

selective_attention.name: Focus
selective_attention.what: Staying on what matters despite distractions.
selective_attention.example: Reading in a noisy cafe or ignoring notifications while you study.

cognitive_flexibility.name: Flexibility
cognitive_flexibility.example: Alternating between two subjects, or adapting when instructions change midway.

processing_speed.name: Speed
processing_speed.what: How quickly you take in information and respond.
processing_speed.example: Braking when a light turns red, or answering a quick question.

inductive_reasoning.name: Reasoning
inductive_reasoning.what: Spotting a pattern and working out the rule.
inductive_reasoning.example: Understanding the logic of a new kind of exercise without being told.

nback_spatial.name: Grid Memory
nback_spatial.how: Squares light up one at a time on a grid. Press "Same" when the lit square is in the same place as {n} step(s) ago.
nback_spatial.tip: It is normal to miss some: the game is built to be challenging.
nback_spatial.post_summary: Your working memory was actively engaged. Each session steadily refines your profile.

flanker.name: Arrow Focus
flanker.how: Five arrows appear. Press the key for the direction of the middle arrow only, and ignore the others.
flanker.tip: Go fast, but try not to make mistakes.
flanker.post_summary: Your focus and ability to ignore distractions have been recorded.

task_switching.name: Rule Switch
task_switching.how: A digit appears with a symbol. A blue circle: say if it is odd or even. An orange square: say if it is smaller or larger than 5. The rule changes as you play.
task_switching.tip: Check the symbol each time before you answer.
task_switching.cue_parity: Blue circle: Decide if the digit is Odd or Even
task_switching.cue_magnitude: Orange square: Decide if the digit is Less than or Greater than 5
task_switching.post_summary: Your cognitive flexibility and adaptation to rule changes have been updated.

choice_rt.name: Quick Reaction
choice_rt.how: A box lights up. Press the matching key as fast as you can.
choice_rt.tip: Stay ready, but do not press before the box lights up.
choice_rt.cue: Press as soon as a box lights up
choice_rt.post_summary: Your reaction speed and motor consistency have been integrated into your model.

matrix_reasoning.name: Pattern Puzzle
matrix_reasoning.how: A grid of shapes has one empty square. Pick the shape that completes the logic.
matrix_reasoning.tip: If you are unsure, trust your best guess and move on.
matrix_reasoning.cue: Select the shape that completes the grid logically
matrix_reasoning.post_summary: Your pattern recognition and inductive deduction have been recorded.

stats.score_body: It is a personal reference point on a scale from 0 to 100. It is not a grade, not an IQ and not a medical result. Compare it only with your own earlier results: it is there to show your progress.
stats.range_title: Why a range and not one number?
stats.range_body: A few minutes of play cannot give an exact value. The range shows where your level most likely lies. The more you play, the narrower it gets.
stats.projection_title: Where you could be in a few weeks
stats.projection_body: If you keep practising, your level may move along this path. The wider the band, the less certain the forecast.
stats.profile_note: These are estimates from a few minutes of play. They change with practice.

collab.title: How you work with your coach
collab.intro: This score looks at how you use the coach: asking clearly, checking its advice, improving step by step, staying in charge and using it wisely.

C.name: Asks clearly
C.what: You explain what you need and why.

V.name: Checks the advice
V.what: You ask for reasons or question a suggestion instead of just accepting it.

I.name: Builds step by step
I.what: You use feedback to try again and improve.

A.name: Stays in charge
A.what: You decide for yourself and ask for help when it is useful.

R.name: Uses it wisely
R.what: You take breaks and keep sessions to a healthy length.

collab.locked: Chat with your coach and answer a few suggestions to unlock this.

coach.name: Your coach
coach.first_run: Let's start by getting to know how you think: five short games, about 6 minutes.

privacy.title: Your data stays yours
privacy.body: We keep your reaction times, answers and chat with the coach. We never use your camera or microphone, and we never ask for your name or email. You can download or delete everything at any time.
privacy.retention_desc: Your logs are stored with a pseudonymous identifier and automatically purged after the chosen retention window.
privacy.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to permanently delete all your data?
privacy.delete_success: All your data has been permanently deleted.

home.pending_skills_title: Your skills (waiting for your first game)
home.default_coach_reason: Your recent sessions suggest a short focus exercise is ideal today.

profile.scientists_desc: Gaussian state parameters (μ, σ, Q=2.5), Kalman gains and quadratic outlier damping (|z| > 3.0).

demo.title: Demonstration Personas
demo.subtitle: Test how the dynamic model, uncertainty ranges, and Nova coach react to different behavioural profiles.

steady_improver.name: Steady Improver
steady_improver.desc: 10 simulated sessions with low variability and high accuracy. Demonstrates steady narrowing of the uncertainty band (σ < 6.0).

variable_responder.name: Variable Responder
variable_responder.tagline: Reaction time variability with occasional lapses
variable_responder.desc: Shows occasional lapses of attention. Demonstrates outlier detection (z > 3) and damping without distorting the profile.

fatigue_pattern.name: Fatigue Pattern
fatigue_pattern.desc: 4 sessions on the same day with increasing reaction times. Triggers the coach rest suggestion to support consolidation.

consent.acknowledge_check: I understand that AI4BRAIN is a personal learning tool and does not constitute a medical, psychological, or diagnostic evaluation.

results.title: Your initial profile
results.default_coach_note: Your initial games provide a starting foundation. The ranges will narrow over your next sessions for an increasingly precise estimate.

how_it_works_page.title: How it works
how_it_works_page.subtitle: A transparent look at how AI4BRAIN estimates cognitive growth without clinical labels.
how_it_works_page.s1_body: Five everyday functional skills: Memory, Focus, Flexibility, Speed, and Reasoning. Each is tied to a validated cognitive task protocol.
how_it_works_page.s2_title: 2. How a game becomes an estimate
how_it_works_page.s2_body: Each response time and accuracy metric updates a dynamic Bayesian model. Instead of giving a single fragile score, your results gradually narrow down a probability range.
how_it_works_page.s3_body: The range reflects genuine uncertainty. Early sessions have wider intervals because the model needs repeated observations. As you play more, the band narrows into a stable estimate.
how_it_works_page.s4_title: 4. What the coach does and why it explains itself
how_it_works_page.s4_body: Nova recommends the exercise with the best growth potential. Every recommendation comes with a plain-language explanation and verifiable decision factors — never arbitrary choices.
how_it_works_page.s5_body: AI4BRAIN is not a medical device, not a psychological diagnosis, and not an IQ test. We never compare you to population norms or rank you against others.
